Settings.title: Settings Guide
Settings.description: Follow the steps below to secure your account and customize your preferences.

steps.step1Description: Click on your avatar in the top-right corner to open your profile settings.
steps.step2Description: In the sidebar, select Security to manage your password, 2FA, and sessions.
steps.step3Description: Enter your current password, then choose a new one and confirm.
steps.step4Description: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app and enter the code shown.
